parties: Om Freight Forwarders Limited; Harmesh Rahul Joshi
headline: Harmesh Rahul Joshi files substantial acquisition disclosure in Om Freight Forwarders
sum: Harmesh Rahul Joshi has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Code, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Om Freight Forwarders Limited; the disclosure was submitted to NSE and formally announced on 16 June 2026.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure signals entry into or crossing of a 5% threshold; triggers public announcement obligations and potential open offer requirements depending on cumulative acquisition level—material for tracking acquiror intent and shareholder notification timelines.
detail: Harmesh Rahul Joshi has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition event in Om Freight Forwarders Limited. The filing was released via NSE's corporate action archive. The specific acquisition quantum, consideration, and whether an open offer is triggered remain to be disclosed in full Form A or Form B filings. This is the initial public disclosure; further substantive transaction details and regulatory outcomes will follow.

framework.note: Central: Mandates disclosure of substantial acquisition; triggers at 5% threshold and every 2% thereafter.
Central: Define 'acquirer', 'target' and 'public announcement' requirements; frame open offer thresholds (25%, 26%+).
Central: Open offer trigger at 25% or more; mandatory public announcement and shareholder protection framework.
Complementary: Acquiror pledge disclosure and insider trading prohibitions during offer period.
Procedural: Requires immediate disclosure of material events including substantial acquisitions.
Amended: Board approval and timing restrictions on trading during acquisition process.

conditions: Potential open offer trigger if cumulative holding reaches 25% or more
approvals: Stock exchange approval of disclosure filing
